description: Source code for table actions in the Notesnook editor, including functions for moving table rows/columns, importing/exporting CSV data, and interacting with the editor's table structure.

methods.name: moveColumnRight
methods.description: Moves the selected table column one position to the right if possible.

methods.name: moveColumnLeft
methods.description: Moves the selected table column one position to the left if possible.

methods.name: moveRowDown
methods.description: Moves the selected table row down by one position if possible.

methods.name: moveRowUp
methods.description: Moves the selected table row up by one position if possible.

methods.name: selectRow
methods.description: Selects the next or previous row relative to the current selection.

methods.name: selectColumn
methods.description: Selects the next or previous column relative to the current selection.

methods.name: importCsvToTable
methods.description: Imports CSV data into the table, creating new table rows and cells.

methods.name: exportToCSV
methods.description: Exports the selected table as a CSV file, with permission check.
